name: mister-handy
description: Mister Handy: the main session is HQ and orchestrates by default. A SessionStart hook marks HQ vs worker; HQ sends every substantive task out as a written brief to Orca worktrees, or to background subagents in git worktrees without Orca, then watches them through a STATUS file and acts when they finish, fail, ask or stall, without pulling transcripts back in. Briefs with runnable acceptance checks are routed by Jev to cheap workers (pi on NAN models) under a deterministic foreman that retries, climbs a model ladder and escalates to Claude.
